answer: Make self-dealing impossible: rewards unlock only for services delivered to protocol-assigned strangers. Each epoch the chain randomly pairs agents, and every identity must render real work to its assigned counterpart, who attests receipt before any payout. A sybil farmer's puppets get scattered among strangers instead of trading with each other; faking the loop means doing the work N times over, so the margin collapses. Sybil clusters wash off like pigment on a karst wall once rewards stop flowing to the farmer's own hands, and the sweetest nectar here is earned, never self-poured.
